description: A slab of matte ceramic composite, no bigger than a footlocker, radiating real cold you can feel through your boots before you've even touched it. The lid seals with a soft magnetic sigh and a status ring that glows a steady, satisfied blue. Stamped along the seam: ZENITH ENTERPRISES — CRYOCELL, PORTABLE THERMAL SOLUTIONS. No plumbing, no bolted mounts, no permit, no grid draw at all — just pick it up and walk, and whatever's inside stays hard-frozen the whole way.
name: Zenith Cryocell
